title: Campus Program Amounts in the 2026-27 Fine Arts Fee Schedule: Hollis Middle School and Calloway Creek High School (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**Campus program amount.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the 2026-27 Fine Arts fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** adds a campus program amount by the campus on the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year, as Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions records it: plus 10.00 for Hollis Middle School, plus 20.00 for Calloway Creek High School, and nothing otherwise.

| Campus on that enrollment record | Campus program amount |
|---|---|
| Hollis Middle School | plus 10.00 |
| Calloway Creek High School | plus 20.00 |
| Ridgecrest Middle School, Mesquite Ridge High School or any other campus | nothing |
| no enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | nothing |

The campus read is the one on the enrollment record, not the campus named on the activity participation; where the two differ, the enrollment record decides.
